newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Jardine exec to join CS First Boston.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Jardine exec to join CS First Boston.

text.p: Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd executive Greg Terry told Reuters on Friday that he would join the CS First Boston (CSFB) investment bank in Australia from the start of May.

Jardine Matheson, an Asian conglomerate with its primary listing in Singapore, said earlier that Terry, an executive director, had accepted a senior investment banking appointment in his home town of Melbourne. It did not identify the firm.
Terry, the legal counsel at the company based in the Hong Kong headquarters, said he would become vice chairman-Pacific Region and managing director of the global firm at CS First Boston.
CSFB is the investment banking arm of Credit Suisse.
